# Draft:Sails Software

Sails Software is an Indian information technology company based in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, that provides software development and artificial intelligence services. The company works in areas such as cloud computing, SaaS, data analytics and digital transformation.
In November 2025, Sails Software was among several companies involved in a ₹3,800 crore technology investment initiative in Visakhapatnam, announced by the Government of Andhra Pradesh. As part of this initiative, the company announced plans to establish an Advanced Software Innovation and AI Excellence Centre at the IT Hill in Madhurawada, with an estimated investment of around ₹21 crore. News reports stated that the facility is expected to generate between 300 and 430 information technology jobs.
